title: OptiSkill: A Hierarchical and Evolving SkillBank for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.22987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated operations research (OR) modeling requires LLMs to translate natural-language decision problems into correct mathematical programs. Existing methods can improve individual formulations, but they often solve problems in isolation, retaining little reusable experience and repeating similar formulation errors. Prior memory-based approaches store examples, thoughts, or insights as references, while OR modeling requires reusable formulation skills that transfer across problem narratives and guide concrete modeling decisions. We propose OptiSkill, a skill-augmented framework that builds a hierarchical and evolving SkillBank for LLM-based OR modeling. SkillBank stores solver-verified experience as reusable skills, with Global Strategies for problem-level formulation skeletons and Step Experiences for local error-prevention rules. translated_title: OptiSkill：面向基于大语言模型的优化建模的分层演化技能库
translated_abstract: 自动化运筹学（OR）建模要求大语言模型将自然语言描述的决策问题转化为正确的数学规划。现有方法虽能改进单个建模，但往往孤立地解决问题，几乎不保留可复用的经验，并会重复类似的建模错误。先前基于记忆的方法将示例、思路或见解存储为参考，而运筹学建模真正需要的是可跨问题情境迁移、并能指导具体建模决策的可复用建模技能。我们提出OptiSkill，一个技能增强框架，为基于大语言模型的运筹学建模构建分层且不断演化的技能库。SkillBank将经求解器验证的经验存储为可复用技能，其中“全局策略”提供问题级的建模骨架，“步骤经验”提供局部防错规则。该技能库进一步通过稳定的批量级测试时演化得到精炼，其中候选技能被纳入……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: OptiSkill提出一个分层演化的技能库框架，将求解器验证的建模经验组织为全局策略和步骤经验两类可复用技能，并通过测试时演化持续精炼，使大语言模型在运筹学优化建模中能跨问题复用经验、减少重复建模错误。
en_tdlr: OptiSkill introduces a hierarchical and evolving SkillBank that stores solver-verified formulation skills (global strategies and step experiences) and refines them through test-time evolution, enabling LLMs to reuse transferable experience for more accurate operations research modeling.
